meta.title: Related-Party Screening: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Sign in as a Compliance Officer on a Growth-plan tenant and verify Related-Party Screening is refused or absent.
Repeat the same Related-Party Screening workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify it is available and works.
Compare the capability outcome across tenants with different subscription plans.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a Compliance Officer on a Growth-plan tenant and verify Related-Party Screening is refused or absent.; Repeat the same Related-Party Screening workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify it is available and works.; Compare the capability outcome across tenants with different subscription plans.

args.need: sign in as the Compliance Officer, test Related-Party Screening on the Growth tenant and then on the Enterprise tenant, and report whether the capability is absent or refused on Growth and usable on Enterprise

steps.note: The catalog cannot access the Compliance Officer role, Related-Party Screening workflow, or plan entitlement comparison.
If the tester leaves the Enterprise workflow on screen, confirm that the named capability is visible; this does not establish the plan-specific behavior.
